notes: 1.0.0 is the verified public baseline; GHSA-j5rx-vm8v-f7p3 is fixed there.
Issue #509 tracks recovery as 1.0.2 after the 1.0.1 bootstrap-1 run published three distributions but bootstrap-2 rejected its candidate.
1.0.1 is an incomplete publication with no release tag; do not reuse or recommend that synchronized version.
The 1.0.2 candidate must pass current CI, maintainer review and three protected release.yml dispatches from one accepted main commit.

gates.title: Release commit has a clean working tree
Execution semantics are complete
gates.detail: The 1.0.0 execution baseline is published. Directly constructed plans enforce declared policies. The local 1.0.2 full suite passed (3656 tests, 36 skipped); candidate CI and maintainer review remain pending.

gates.title: Performance budgets are enforced
gates.detail: The 15 calibrated performance budgets in docs/performance/budgets.json are unchanged from 1.0.0. The 1.0.2 CI performance lane and maintainer review are pending.

gates.title: Interoperability conformance is demonstrated
gates.detail: Version-pinned host fixtures established the published 1.0.0 interoperability baseline. The carried security fixes touch core, HTTP and MCP boundaries; 1.0.2 conformance CI and maintainer review are pending.

gates.title: Security program is reviewed
gates.detail: The 1.0.0 adversarial review is recorded in docs/THREAT_MODEL.md. The 1.0.2 candidate carries four post-1.0.0 security fixes: direct plan authorization, scope denial redaction, viewer-specific cache control and HTTP method matching. The local full suite and locked-runtime pip-audit passed with no known vulnerabilities; candidate CI and maintainer disposition remain required.

gates.title: Public API is ready for stability
gates.detail: The 1.0.2 patch adds no public API exports. The 166-name 1.0.0 inventory in docs/releases/1.0-api-classification.md remains the baseline; import and compatibility CI plus maintainer review are pending.

gates.title: Documentation reproduces supported applications
gates.detail: The 1.0.2 release notes describe the upgrade and partial 1.0.1 publication. All seven 1.0.2 wheels installed in a fresh Python 3.14 environment without first-party index access, with import and CLI smoke checks passing; CI and maintainer review are pending.

gates.title: Publication workflow is rehearsed
gates.detail: The candidate checker accepts GitHub's bare workflow path while retaining exact commit pinning. All fourteen 1.0.2 artifacts built and validated, seven wheels installed cleanly, SBOM verified, and online bootstrap-1 readiness passed with no 1.0.2 files on PyPI. Candidate CI, protected-environment approval, PyPI verification and maintainer review remain pending.
